sections.title: AER
sections.text_preview: The imager uses AER output format. The address-event (AE) communication channel is a model of the transmission of neural information in biological systems [14]. Information is presented at the output in the form of a sequence of pulses or spikes, where the interspike interval or the spike frequency encodes the analog value of the data being communicated.
